name: Iyashi no Megami no Marmot
original_name: 癒しの女神の実験台（モルモット）
source:
After working continuously in a shady business, his body and soul are in shambles. As he was walking without an umbrella in the rain, a woman called out to him:

“Have you been comforted lately?”

Arriving at the address on the business card he had received, he was enlisted as a ‘massage model’ (also known as a marmot) at the comfort industry specialty school, Shichijou Salon Arts Academy. His body, soul and nether regions, are comforted by the whispers of the goddesses at the school. Will he be able to safely regain his healthy body!?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/09/28/september-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
连续在见不得光的行业工作后，他的身心都已支离破碎。某天，他在雨中没有打伞地走着，一名女性向他搭话：

“最近有人安慰过你吗？”

他按照名片上的地址来到按摩专业学校七条沙龙艺术学院，并被登记为“按摩模特”（也称为土拨鼠）。学校里的女神们用低语安抚他的身体、灵魂和下半身。他能平安恢复健康吗！？

[来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/09/28/september-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
